card.name: Inside pep- words like peptide
card.fires_on: The split-off piece in the middle of words starting with pep/pept, such as peptidase, peptidoglycan, Peptococcus, peppermint. Also seen in a few other drug-name pieces like cephalosporin and fosaprepitant.

modes.label: Peptide words
modes.description: The 'pt' or 'ep' piece inside peptide-related terms such as peptidase or peptidoglycan.
modes.example: Cell wall is composed of a thick layer of pe<<pt>>idoglycan surrounding the cell membrane

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: Early pieces of other long names such as peppermint or cephalosporin.
modes.example: << pepp>>ermint oil and its natural healing

card.writes: Little clear meaning; it seems to push toward odd word-fragment continuations.
card.plain: It fires partway through long words that begin like peptide, such as peptidase or Peptococcus.
